snippet.title: FIRST MAJOR UPDATE! | Leaks In Space
snippet.description:
Leaks in Space is finally getting its first major update after releasing as EA. This wouldn’t have been possible without YOU and your suggestions on the Steam Community and Discord, and those few but super helpful bug reports! 

Check out the Steam Announcement for more details about this update: 

As an added bonus, Leaks In Space is 30% off from today till May 11th.
Here: https://store.steampowered.com/app/3561170?utm_source=y
